decisions.reason: Compares release-log (build 16:22 before bump 16:23) with baked PLUGIN_VERSION 0.3.6 in v0.3.7 bundle, explains newerTag self-update, no runtime manifest reread, and prescribes bump-before-build plus inspecting the emitted constant; keeps v0.3.8 separate.

Uses PNG 200 vs SVG 404 unsupported-type and disk lib/index.js permitting SVG to pin the stale boot-time handler; requires host restart, notes client refresh is insufficient, and stays scoped to this host lifecycle.

Clean source XML and typed read vs spliced model-visible persisted text locates corruption in upstream result-text assembly; plugin consumes the damaged copy, disk file is innocent, and repair of the good SVG is rejected.

Ordered chain: disk bytes via asset route, session payload only after DOMParser/parsererror XML validation, sandboxed iframe with scripts blocked while SMIL runs, and explicit error state; validation failure never reaches the iframe unchecked.

Plans concatenated-Zstandard frame-by-frame decode preserving order, reconstructing the JSONL event with the stored splice, comparison and upstream report; checklist covers bump-before-build, shipped-constant and per-mirror tag SHA verification, and plane-specific probes.

caps.reason: Final advice never endorses bump-after-build, tag repush as fix, refresh-instead-of-restart, SVG editing, unvalidated payload rendering, or scripted fallback.
